guardians_artist_init_01 = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				has_leviathans = yes
				add = @spawn_system_extreme
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				is_fe_cluster = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_star_flag = empire_cluster
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = { guardians_artists_system enclave }
	init_effect = {
		create_country = { name = "NAME_Artisan_Troupe" type = enclave }
	}
}

guardians_curator_init_01 = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				OR = {
					has_leviathans = yes
					has_distar = yes
					has_grand_archive_dlc = yes
				}
				add = @spawn_system_enclave
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				is_fe_cluster = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_star_flag = empire_cluster
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = { guardians_curators_system enclave }
	planet = {
		init_effect = {
			create_country = { name = "NAME_Curator_Order" type = enclave }
		}
	}
}

guardians_init_dragon = {
	class = sc_k
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				has_leviathans = yes
				add = 100
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				OR = {
					is_fe_cluster = yes
					has_star_flag = empire_cluster
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				is_bottleneck_system = yes
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = { guardians_dragon_system guardian hostile_system antique_threat_system }
	planet = {
		init_effect = {
			create_country = { name = "NAME_Voidwyrm" type = guardian_dragon }
		}
	}
}
